faultRegister.title: ASTRA Hardware Fault Register
faultRegister.subtitle: DRDO / iDEX PS 26054 - Reference engine Rotax 915 iS - read from the code, 16 Sep 2026
faultRegister.file: Desktop/ASTRA Hardware Fault Register.html (content in ASTRA Hardware Fault Register_files/saved_resource.html)
faultRegister.role: Source of truth for the fault taxonomy, wording, mechanisms, signatures and rule lists.

files: layer1_edge/can_ingest.py (ValueState, ingest channel names, derived quantities)

codeCrossCheck.role: Used only to obtain exact identifiers (enum values, channel names, rule ids and levels) for things the register names by function. Where code and register differ, the register wins and the difference is recorded.

engineDocumentation.title: BRP-Rotax Operators Manual 915 i A Series Ed.0 Rev.1
engineDocumentation.role: Component identification and cylinder numbering (already stored in the GLB node extras). p66: liquid cooled cylinder heads, ram air cooled cylinders, cooling air baffle; p69: radiator installed below the engine (airframe side).

conventions.directComponents: Hardware the register names as failing (or its closest modelled host). Receives the fault render state.
conventions.contextComponents: Hardware that explains or locates the fault. Receives HIGHLIGHT_CONTEXT only - never a warning colour.

precision.EXACT: The mesh is exactly the named part (or exactly the named cylinder's part).
precision.BANK_SHARED: One mesh serves both cylinders of a bank; highlighting it also lights the partner cylinder's part.
precision.ENGINE_SHARED: One mesh serves all four cylinders.
precision.HOST: The physical fault location is inside this mesh and not modelled separately.
precision.GROUP_AGGREGATE: One mesh holds several physical instruments/parts that cannot be addressed individually.
precision.APPROXIMATE: The modelled physics has no dedicated geometry; this is the nearest defensible representation.
precision.INSTRUMENT: The mesh is the instrument that produces the listed channel.

conventions.unlistedComponents: Every component not listed stays NORMAL (optionally GHOSTED when camera.ghostNonInvolved is true and the fault is focused).

1.verification: Numbering per BRP-Rotax OM 915 i A §7.1.4 Fig.2 (stored in GLB extras). Verified on the GLB: cylinder, head, valve cover, piston and rod of each cylinder lie on the same side of the crank axis; cylinders 1 and 2 are at the PTO (+X Blender) end; the coolant temperature sensor is nearest head 4.

cameraConvention: camera.position = centre(frameComponents live bounds) + viewDirectionGltf * max(radius * distanceFactor, minDistanceM); look at the centre; vertical FOV about 23 deg (50 mm on a 36 mm sensor, 16:9). viewDirectionGltf is in glTF/three.js world space (+Y up).
